name: Magus
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low Perception; high Arcana; high Str or Dex, moderate or high Int; high AC; low to moderate HP; moderate accuracy; high to extreme spell DC; prepared arcane spellcasting as a magus of their level; conflux spells; Spellstrike, Arcane Cascade; Magus hybrid study abilities

notes.attributes: High Strength or Dexterity, moderate or high Intelligence.
notes.defense: High AC; low to moderate HP.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC. Prepared arcane spellcasting as a magus of its level: {maxrank}. Conflux spells.
notes.specials: Spellstrike, Arcane Cascade, hybrid study abilities.
